_comment: What the review derivation reads and ignores. Shared by every tool through review_tree.py. source_globs are relative to the repository root; exclude_dirs match any path segment; exclude_paths match a prefix.

self._comment: The self set reviews the tool itself: review/tools and review/ui, with their own intent written from the review brief.

anchors._comment: The kinds of node a chain of evidence ends on: a person can open each and see the thing itself, so the graph does not continue past it (diminishing returns). claims.py turns a claim's evidence refs into anchor nodes of these kinds; a shipped claim with no anchor that resolves fails the build.

file.resolves: the path exists in the repository
file.opens: in the navigator (review-source) when the site serves it; on GitHub at the release commit otherwise

test.opens: in the navigator; run by the gate on every release

doc.opens: the rendered page on the site

url.resolves: the host is this site or GitHub
url.opens: the page itself, which is the evidence

commit.resolves: the sha is a release commit in data/versions.json

tag.resolves: the tag is a release in data/versions.json

run.resolves: the id is a release run in data/versions.json
run.opens: the Actions run on GitHub: validate, tag, deploy, verify-live
